why: phase-428 Q1 follow-through (2026-09-06) — `nros::env::rmw_selector() -> Option<heapless::String<RMW_SELECTOR_CAP>>` (`packages/api/nros/src/env.rs:154`): the one `$NROS_RMW` reader, naming the registry slot a multi-backend image opens against. rclrs has no counterpart: a ROS 2 desktop process selects its middleware with `RMW_IMPLEMENTATION` and a dynamic loader, and there is nothing to select at runtime in an image that linked exactly one backend — the same reasoning as `c:support_init_rmw`. The cap is `Executor::primary_rmw_name`'s capacity, so an over-long value reads as unset rather than truncated into another backend's name.
